title: H03 — Price Normality (Easy)
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Check if the distribution of house prices follows a normal distribution. Consider the distribution as normal if the absolute value of skewness is less than 0.5. Calculate skewness using Python's built-in function. Report your answer in this exact format: @price_distribution[status] where status is either normal or not_normal.
notes: The logged exec call contains a technically correct manual skewness formula — script itself is sound.
Extraction only captures the tool CALL, not its stdout — the claimed skewness=0 could not be verified from this data alone and is very unlikely to be correct given ground truth is not_normal.
